Nina (eng-security): New pen-test intake — retest Fri 09:00-13:00 UTC. Need confirmations by Thu EOD: 1) ephemeral RBAC for assessors; 2) KMS decrypt gating; 3) audit export + retention. Also want a deployment freeze and clear rollback behavior.

Raj (eng-sre): We'll create `pt-assessor-ephemeral` role w/ s3:GetObject & s3:ListBucket scoped to arn:aws:s3:::sec-evidence/pt-2026-120/*. Max session 8h. Require assessor account IDs.

Nina (eng-security): Sending vendor IDs in DM. For KMS, prefer CMK Condition on aws:RequestTag/pt=true so we can require sts:TagSession.

Raj (eng-sre): Good call. Will enforce sts:TagSession and add CMK Condition: StringEquals aws:RequestTag/pt = "true". Alternatively we can issue a KMS grant tied to the role if we need quick revoke.

Sofia (eng-ops): Logs -> s3://sec-evidence/pt-2026-120/raw/, CloudTrail + app JSON + ALB. Retention: 90d hot, archive 1y. We'll run a redaction dry-run with synthetic data Tue 16:00 UTC and post a presigned sample.

Marco (eng-platform): Freeze Fri 07:00-15:00 UTC. Canary thresholds: auto-rollback if 5xx > 1% for 5m or median latency +150ms. Fallback route to smaller model variant. I'll add runbook link.

sec-bot: Intake created SEC-2026-120. Manifest path: pt-2026-120/manifest.json. Dry-run Tue 16:00 UTC. Oncall: @Raj. Ticket: https://redwood.internal/security/tickets/SEC-2026-120

Raj (eng-sre): Plan: manifest with presigned URLs for >50MB objects, presign TTL 12h in dry-run. Will post role ARN + trust policy Thu EOD.

Sofia (eng-ops): Redaction dry-run scheduled. Will share presigned sample here after verification.

Nina (eng-security): Owners: Raj = role + CMK snippet + manifest; Sofia = redaction + lifecycle + SIEM hookup; Marco = freeze + canary + runbook. Readiness check Thu 19:00 UTC in #eng-security. Final checklist: role ARN, KMS policy/grant, presigned manifest, redacted sample, lifecycle & CloudTrail, freeze calendar entry, evidence README. Flag issues here. Thanks :pray:
